basics.label: Software Engineer
basics.headline: A ship in harbor is safe, but that is not what ships are built for.
basics.summary:
I'm sggmico, a frontend developer advancing towards becoming a full-stack Web3 engineer.

With 10+ years of frontend development experience and 3+ years of practical experience at major internet companies, I have a solid foundation in frontend technologies, am well-versed in web development architecture, and proficient in mainstream development frameworks and open-source ecosystems.

With 2+ years of deep expertise in Web3, I'm familiar with blockchain fundamentals and Ethereum technology, with deep understanding of decentralization and digital assets. I'm proficient in Solidity smart contract development and master the complete contract development lifecycle (development, testing, deployment, maintenance). I'm familiar with ERC standards (ERC20/721/1155) and security contract libraries like OpenZeppelin, with blockchain security awareness. I've participated in NFT ecosystem development with complete experience from NFT generation, rarity processing to contract deployment and marketplace listing.

I possess agile project management capabilities, ensuring code quality and efficient iteration through automated testing, code reviews, and CI/CD practices. I excel at breaking down complex problems and transforming them into actionable technical solutions, and am skilled in technical challenges and process automation.

I'm passionate about creating user-friendly and beautiful interface experiences, pursuing a balance between usability and design aesthetics. I actively participate in the open-source community, continuously follow technology trends, and enjoy exploring new tools and cutting-edge technologies.
